messages:
product_jane: Heads-up: PMs approved a packaging change that increases default rate limits for Pro by ~2.5x and boosts quota for devs for the first 30 days. Launch window targeted for 2024-06-15. Need an infra capacity forecast + mitigation plan for the first 72h spike. Can SRE/infra triage?

mohamed: Copy. Quick gut check: if traffic really spikes 2.5x for 72h with some sustained uplift (~20%), we should expect ~~40% concurrency increase on generation endpoints and a ~15-25% lift in embedding requests.

mohamed: I ran a quick sim with last quarter's traffic profile scaled 2.5x for 72h: command I used: `./simulate_traffic --profile=q2-prod --mult=2.5 --duration=72h --mix=gen:0.7,emb:0.3`

mohamed: Results (rough): additional GPU hours needed ~120 A100-equivalent GPU-hours/day (burst window). Peak node count +35-45 nodes in us-west1 region for ~6-10 hours/day. Network egress +~3.2TB/day in peak. Estimated incremental infra cost ~ $16k-22k/week if on-demand cloud.

diana: We should avoid full instant ramp. Recommend staged quota ramp + soft rate caps on new signups: e.g., day0 cap = 1.5x baseline, day1 = 2.0x, day3 = 2.5x. That smooths queueing and KV cache warm-up.
diana: Also propose regional canary: enable new limits for 5% of traffic in eu-west1 + 10% in us-west1 for first 24h, observe latency and queue depth.

mohamed: Agreed. Additional mitigation: fallback to quantized model variants (q4/q8) for non-critical routes when queue depth > 200ms or GPU util > 78%. Example fallback rule (pseudo):
```
route: /v1/generate
if gpu_util > 78% or queue_ms > 200:
  model: redwood-ggml-q4-mini
  priority: best-effort
```

alana: Can we pre-warm dedicated pools? If we reserve some Dedicated capacity we get predictable latency and avoid autoscaler cold starts. Estimated reserved commit: 20 nodes for 72h = procurement/finance ask.

finance_bob: FYI: 20-node reserved for a week will need an exception; ballpark cost on cloud reserved = ~$75k/week; monthly commit options may be cheaper but need lead time. Open to opt for short-term on-demand + cheaper quantized fallback.

monitoring-bot: Created dashboard: "pricing-change-2024-06-capacity" and alert group "pc-capacity-crit" (targets @eng-sre oncall).

mohamed: Action items I propose:
- I -> run full sim across regions + model mixes (ETA 24h) and produce GPU-hour-by-region table.
- diana -> prepare runbook + canary config and test traffic rake (ETA 48h).
- alana -> confirm whether Product can do staged quota ramp schedule and cutover plan (ETA EOD).
- finance_bob -> estimate short-term procurement options and approvals needed (ETA 48h).

product_jane: Thanks — pushing for a staged schedule. Please post the sim outputs and runbook here when ready. If we hit a hard blocker, we can delay launch by 1 week.

diana: One more note: network/transit constraints in eu-west1 are somewhat tight around 08:00-12:00 UTC historically; recommend avoiding global switch at that time.

mohamed: I'll attach sim CSVs and capacity chart to the dashboard. Preliminary numbers look manageable if we do staged ramp+fallback. If product insists on full open roll, we need either an extra 50% headroom or a short reserved pool.

alana: I'll sync w/PM and ops - will update thread. :thumbsup:

product_jane: Great — marking this as high priority. <!here> please review the dashboard once updates are in.
